CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which tool is good for smudging charcoal? (1 mark)
   A. A stone
   B. A wet brush of paint
   C. A finger or a tissue
   D. A knife

2. What is charcoal? (1 mark)
   A. A type of clay
   B. A kind of wet paint
   C. Ground chalk
   D. Black carbon left when wood is heated with little air

3. Which two positions are defenders that may enter the goal circle they defend? (1 mark)
   A. WA and C
   B. GD and GK
   C. WD and WA
   D. GS and C

4. A full netball court is divided into how many equal parts? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Three
   C. Six
   D. Two

5. A lighter tone of a colour is called a (1 mark)
   A. tint
   B. outline
   C. primary
   D. shade

6. How long does a crotchet rest last? (1 mark)
   A. One beat
   B. No time
   C. Half a beat
   D. Two beats

7. Free hand lettering means writing letters (1 mark)
   A. by hand without a ruler or stencil
   B. with a printing machine
   C. in capital letters only
   D. with a ruler only

8. Which of these letters is a tall letter with an ascender? (1 mark)
   A. n
   B. x
   C. t
   D. u

9. The Kodaly hand sign for r is (1 mark)
   A. a flat hand held level
   B. a sloping palm
   C. a wave
   D. a closed fist

10. Which is the highest of the notes d, r and m? (1 mark)
   A. m
   B. r
   C. They are all the same
   D. d

11. What should you do after crossing the finish line? (1 mark)
   A. Push others
   B. Turn around fast
   C. Slow down gradually
   D. Stop suddenly

12. What is the last part of the sequence in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Getting up slowly and standing tall
   B. Running away
   C. Jumping
   D. Rolling backwards

13. A balance in gymnastics is (1 mark)
   A. a fast run
   B. a jump into water
   C. a throw
   D. a position held still for a few seconds

14. In which direction should a side roll travel? (1 mark)
   A. Round and round in place
   B. In a straight line along the mat
   C. Backwards over your head
   D. In a curve off the mat

15. Which folk songs welcome a new baby? (1 mark)
   A. Initiation songs
   B. Naming songs
   C. Funeral songs
   D. Work songs

16. What does good diction mean? (1 mark)
   A. Singing very loudly
   B. Singing with no words
   C. Saying the words clearly
   D. Clapping

17. Which is a digital device for photography? (1 mark)
   A. Recorder
   B. Kayamba
   C. Ruler
   D. Smartphone

18. After taking photos, choosing the best ones is called (1 mark)
   A. painting
   B. hiding
   C. smudging
   D. selecting

19. Indoors, the best place to stand for better light is (1 mark)
   A. under a table
   B. in the cupboard
   C. near a window or open door
   D. in a dark corner

20. What sound do you hear if a hole is not fully covered? (1 mark)
   A. A drum sound
   B. A squeak or weak sound
   C. Nothing at all
   D. A clear note

21. Why keep a recorder away from strong sun and fire? (1 mark)
   A. It becomes invisible
   B. The sun makes it sing
   C. It becomes lighter
   D. Heat can bend it

22. Uncovering holes makes the note (1 mark)
   A. silent
   B. lower
   C. the same
   D. higher

23. In a glide, your face is (1 mark)
   A. turned to the side always
   B. hidden by a hat
   C. high above the water
   D. in the water with the head between your arms

24. Which is a rule for water games? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore the whistle
   B. Do not hold anyone under water
   C. Dunk friends
   D. Play alone

25. Floating means (1 mark)
   A. sinking
   B. swimming fast
   C. staying on top of the water without swimming
   D. diving

26. When playing an animal game, you should play on (1 mark)
   A. broken glass
   B. thorn bushes
   C. soft, clear ground
   D. sharp stones

27. Learning about animals in games links to (1 mark)
   A. Weather forecasts
   B. Space travel
   C. Swimming lessons only
   D. Agriculture

28. Which words describe how loud or soft a performance was? (1 mark)
   A. Tempo
   B. Diction
   C. Pitch
   D. Dynamics

29. Verse 1 of the anthem asks (1 mark)
   A. for money
   B. God to bless the nation
   C. for a new school
   D. for a holiday

30. Sportsmanship means (1 mark)
   A. hitting
   B. cheating to win
   C. teasing others
   D. being fair and kind in sports

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Describe how to draw a drum with tonal value using the smudge technique. (4 marks)

32. Explain how the elongated start is different from the medium start. (4 marks)

33. Give three hygiene rules for the pool. (3 marks)

34. Give four ways of caring for displayed works. (4 marks)

35. Describe how to make flour paste glue. (3 marks)

36. Explain how working in pairs helps when learning the crab balance. (3 marks)

37. State three points of good sprinting technique. (3 marks)

38. How many beats are there in the pattern ta-te ta-te taa taa? Show your working. (3 marks)

39. Explain how a drum makes sound and how its parts work together. (5 marks)

40. Give four safety rules when making charcoal sticks. (4 marks)

41. Name the three secondary colours and state how each is made. (3 marks)

42. Describe how to paint the Kenyan flag on paper. (5 marks)

43. Give three safety measures to observe when playing netball. (3 marks)

44. Why is it important to keep the right posture during a sprint? (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — A finger or a tissue
   A finger or tissue blends charcoal softly.

2. D — Black carbon left when wood is heated with little air
   Charcoal is the black carbon left after wood is burned with very little air.

3. B — GD and GK
   The Goal Defence and the Goal Keeper may play in their defending circle.

4. B — Three
   A netball court is divided into three equal thirds.

5. A — tint
   Adding white makes a tint.

6. A — One beat
   A crotchet rest is one beat of silence.

7. A — by hand without a ruler or stencil
   Free hand means using only your hand.

8. C — t
   The letter t is a tall letter, with a stem that rises above small letters.

9. B — a sloping palm
   Ray is a palm that slopes upward.

10. A — m
   Me is the highest of the three.

11. C — Slow down gradually
   Slowing down gradually is safer.

12. A — Getting up slowly and standing tall
   Finish by standing up slowly with control.

13. D — a position held still for a few seconds
   A balance is a still position that you hold under control.

14. B — In a straight line along the mat
   Rolling in a straight line keeps you on the mat.

15. B — Naming songs
   Naming songs are sung when a baby is named.

16. C — Saying the words clearly
   Clear words help the audience understand the message.

17. D — Smartphone
   A smartphone has a camera lens and digital memory.

18. D — selecting
   Selecting means choosing the best.

19. C — near a window or open door
   Daylight helps.

20. B — A squeak or weak sound
   Leaks make squeaks.

21. D — Heat can bend it
   Heat can warp or crack the instrument.

22. D — higher
   Shorter air column means a higher note.

23. D — in the water with the head between your arms
   Keeping the face in helps the body stay level.

24. B — Do not hold anyone under water
   Safety first.

25. C — staying on top of the water without swimming
   Floating is resting on the surface.

26. C — soft, clear ground
   Soft, clear ground prevents injuries.

27. D — Agriculture
   Agriculture teaches about animals.

28. D — Dynamics
   Dynamics are loud and soft.

29. B — God to bless the nation
   The first verse is a prayer for blessing.

30. D — being fair and kind in sports
   It includes following rules and respecting others.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: Draw the outline lightly. Shade the dark parts by pressing harder and the light parts by pressing lightly. Rub the shading with a finger or tissue to blend. Leave the brightest part white.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: The rear knee is placed further back, level with the heel of the front foot. The feet are further apart. The push is longer and stronger but may feel less steady.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid difference or explanation, up to 4.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Shower before and after; do not spit or pass urine in the pool; do not drink the water; dry yourself and change into dry clothes. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: Do not touch or write on them; keep away from water, sun and dust; keep neat labels; store in the portfolio flat afterwards. Any four.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mix flour with a little cold water to a smooth paste. An adult adds hot water while stirring. Let it cool before use.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: One learner performs while the other watches and checks, gives feedback, and helps if needed. They swap places.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Eyes look ahead; elbows bent and arms swing back and forth; knees lift high; land on the front of the foot; body leans forward slightly. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: 4 beats. Ta-te is 1 beat, ta-te is 1 beat, taa is 1 beat and taa is 1 beat, so 1+1+1+1 = 4.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct stage.

39. (5 marks)
   Answer: The beater or hand strikes the drumhead, which vibrates and makes the sound. The hollow shell makes the sound fuller and louder. The ropes hold the skin tight, and a tighter skin gives a higher sound.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for striking, vibrating skin, shell, ropes, and effect of tightness on pitch.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: An adult does the burning; keep far from the fire; leave the tin closed until cold; collect only dead twigs; wash hands afterwards. Any four.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct rule.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Orange from red and yellow, green from yellow and blue, purple from blue and red.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each secondary colour with its mixture.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: Cut a rectangle of paper in the ratio three to two. Draw the stripes and the thin white lines lightly with a ruler. Sketch the shield and the crossed spears in the middle. Paint black at the top, red in the middle and green at the bottom, leaving the white lines. Let it dry and attach it to a stick.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for the rectangle, drawing stripes, shield, colour order and drying with handle.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Remove jewellery, cut long nails, warm up, wear proper shoes, play on flat ground. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each measure.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: It keeps the body moving forward in a straight line. It saves energy and helps speed. It prevents pain or injury.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.
